metadataVO.title: 喜马拉雅山地区重大地质灾害统计数据集
metadataVO.titleEn: Statistical data set of major geological disasters in Himalayas
metadataVO.description: 本数据集为喜马拉雅山地区重大地质灾害统计数据集，研究区西起阿里地区札达县、葛尔县，东侧以雅鲁藏布江为界，北界为雅鲁藏布江大断裂，南至国界的广大喜马拉雅山地区。喜马拉雅山位于我国的西南边陲，青藏高原的西南，是世界上最大、最高、最年轻的山脉，世界第一高峰珠穆朗玛峰就坐落在这里。这里地质构造复杂、地震活动频发，新构造运动强烈，内外动力地质作用异常活跃，是我国地质灾害最严重的地区之一。该数据集原始数据数字化自《喜马拉雅山地区重大地质灾害遥感调查报告》一书，灾害统计总计540余处，包含滑坡、泥石流和冰川终碛湖溃决三种灾害类型。本数据集对于研究西藏喜马拉雅山地区减灾防灾工作提供了基础数据，对于相关领域的研究具有参考价值。
metadataVO.instructions:
该数据集分为两部分，表格数据和地理数理。
表格数据以Excel格式存储，包含了六张工作簿，依次是县级辖区滑坡灾害统计表、滑坡灾害一览表、县级辖区泥石流灾害统计表、泥石流灾害一览表、县级辖区冰川冰碛湖溃决统计表和冰川冰碛湖溃决灾害隐患一览表。统计表包含了各县区地质灾害级别的统计情况，一览表包含了地质灾害的名称、经纬度、规模、基本形态等信息。
地理数据是对表格数据的可视化结果，以shapefile格式存储。

metadataWordVO.title: Statistical data set of major geological disasters in Himalayas
metadataWordVO.description: This data set is a collection of statistics on major geological disasters in the Himalayas, the study area starts in Zada County, Guer County of The Ali region in the west, the east side is bounded by the Yalu-Zanbu River, the northern boundary is the Yalu-Zanbu River break, south to the vast Himalayan region of the national boundary. The Himalayas are located in the southwest of China, the southwest of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, the world's largest, highest and youngest mountain range, the world's highest peak Mount Qomolangma is located here. Here the geological structure is complex, seismic activity is frequent, the new tectonic movement is strong, the internal and external dynamic geological action is very active, is one of the most serious geological disasters in China. The original data of the data set is digitized from the report of the Remote Sensing Survey of Major Geological Disasters in the Himalayas, and the total number of disaster statistics is more than 540, including three types of disasters: landslides, mudslides and glacial final lake collapses. This data set provides basic data for the study of disaster reduction and prevention in the Himalayas region of Tibet, and is of reference value for research in related fields.
metadataWordVO.userLimit: To respect the intellectual property rights, protect the rights of data authors, expand services of the data center, and evaluate the application potential of data, data users should clearly indicate the source of the data and the author of the data in the research results generated by using the data (including published papers, articles, data products, and unpublished research reports, data products and other results). For re-posting (second or multiple releases) data, the author must also indicate the source of the original data.
metadataWordVO.instructions:
The data set is divided into two parts, table data and geographical mathematics.
The table data is stored in Excel format and contains six workbooks, including landslide disaster statistics table, landslide disaster list, debris flow disaster statistics table, debris flow disaster list, glacier moraine lake outburst statistics table and glacier Moraine Lake Outburst Hazard list in county-level area. The statistical table includes the statistics of geological disaster level of each county and district, and the list includes the name, longitude and latitude, scale, basic form and other information of geological disaster.
Geographic data is the visualization result of table data, which is stored in ShapeFile format.
